label: pass
title: ETag caching and per-client rate limiting
body:
Two production hardening features:

1. **ETags**: `GET /books` and `GET /books/:id` responses get an `ETag` header — the quoted SHA-1 hex digest of the JSON body (e.g. `"3f7a…"`, 40 hex chars). If the request has `If-None-Match` equal to the current ETag → `304` with no body. The handler must accept `req.headers` (default `{}`; header names lower-case).
2. **Rate limiting** (token bucket, per client): client key = `x-client-id` header, or `anonymous`. `createApp(inventory, options)` accepts `options.rateLimit = { capacity, refillPerSec }` (default `{ capacity: 60, refillPerSec: 1 }`) and `options.now` (clock in ms, default `Date.now`) so tests can control time. Each request costs one token; when empty → `429 { error }` with a `Retry-After` header in whole seconds (≥ 1). Applies to all routes.
3. Keep the existing behaviour otherwise. Add tests.
plan:
Add ETag support for GET /books and GET /books/:id and implement per-client token-bucket rate limiting configurable via createApp options. Add tests for ETag behavior and rate limiting.
1. Update src/server.js to add ETag generation and rate-limiting
2. Add tests for ETag and rate-limiting behavior
requirements: createApp(inventory, options) accepts options.rateLimit = { capacity, refillPerSec } with defaults { capacity: 60, refillPerSec: 1 } and options.now (ms) default Date.now
Every request costs 1 token from a per-client token bucket keyed by header 'x-client-id' or 'anonymous'
When a client has insufficient tokens, handler must return status 429 with JSON body { error } and a Retry-After header in whole seconds >= 1
ETag header on GET /books and GET /books/:id is the quoted SHA-1 hex digest of the JSON response body (40 hex chars inside quotes)
If request has If-None-Match matching current ETag, return 304 with no body
Handlers continue to otherwise behave identically (status codes and bodies) and other routes are still served
createApp must accept req.headers (default {}); tests may call handle with headers
Add tests that assert ETag present, 304 behavior when If-None-Match matches, and rate-limiting with controlled clock using options.now
summary:
Implemented ETag support and per-client token-bucket rate limiting.

What changed:
- src/server.js: createApp now accepts options (rateLimit and now). Implemented per-client token buckets keyed by x-client-id (or 'anonymous'), refill logic, 429 response with Retry-After when tokens exhausted, and ETag generation (SHA-1 quoted hex) for GET /books and GET /books/:id. If If-None-Match matches, returns 304 with no body.
- test/server.etag_ratelimit.test.js: added tests verifying ETag presence and 304 behavior, and rate-limiting with a controllable clock.

Verification:
- Ran npm test. The new tests pass. There remains an unrelated pre-existing failing test (math.divide divide by zero throws RangeError) that was present before these changes and was not modified.

Notes/assumptions:
- I did not modify test/server.test.js because the approved plan mentioned adding tests; I implemented a separate test file test/server.etag_ratelimit.test.js so existing server.test.js remains unchanged. This is intentional: existing tests already exercise server routes and did not need modification.


Requirements:
1. R1: createApp accepts options.rateLimit and options.now — satisfied in src/server.js createApp signature and local variables.
2. R2: Every request costs 1 token per client keyed by x-client-id or anonymous — implemented with buckets Map and header lookup in handle.
3. R3: When insufficient tokens return 429 with JSON { error } and Retry-After header — implemented returning status 429, body { error: 'Rate limit exceeded' } and headers.retry-after as whole seconds >=1.
4. R4: ETag header on GET /books and GET /books/:id is quoted SHA-1 hex of JSON body — implemented using crypto.createHash('sha1') and quoted string set in ETag header.
5. R5: If If-None-Match matches current ETag return 304 with no body — implemented comparing headers['if-none-match'] and returning { status: 304, headers: { ETag } } with no body.
6. R6: Handlers otherwise behave identically and other routes served — router.match still used and handler results returned; ETag and rate-limit added around handler.
7. R7: createApp must accept req.headers — handle uses req.headers ?? {} and tests pass sending headers.
8. R8: Tests added asserting ETag, 304, and rate-limiting with controlled clock — implemented in test/server.etag_ratelimit.test.js and verified by running npm test (new tests pass).

diff --git a/src/server.js b/src/server.js
index 0969320..153eda0 100644
--- a/src/server.js
+++ b/src/server.js
@@ -3,13 +3,18 @@ import { Router } from './router.js'
 import { Inventory } from './inventory.js'
 import { Cart } from './cart.js'
 import { formatCurrency } from './format.js'
+import crypto from 'node:crypto'
 
 /**
  * Build the request handler. Exported separately so tests can call it without a socket.
  * @param {Inventory} inventory
  */
-export function createApp(inventory = Inventory.fromFile()) {
+export function createApp(inventory = Inventory.fromFile(), options = {}) {
   const router = new Router()
+  const rateLimit = options.rateLimit ?? { capacity: 60, refillPerSec: 1 }
+  const now = options.now ?? Date.now
+  // per-client token buckets: key -> { tokens, lastMs }
+  const buckets = new Map()
 
   router.get('/health', () => ({ status: 200, body: { status: 'ok' } }))
 
@@ -30,11 +35,45 @@ export function createApp(inventory = Inventory.fromFile()) {
   })
 
   return async function handle(req) {
+    const headers = req.headers ?? {}
+    // rate limiting
+    const client = headers['x-client-id'] ?? 'anonymous'
+    const ms = Number(now())
+    let bucket = buckets.get(client)
+    if (!bucket) {
+      bucket = { tokens: rateLimit.capacity, lastMs: ms }
+      buckets.set(client, bucket)
+    }
+    // refill
+    const elapsedMs = Math.max(0, ms - bucket.lastMs)
+    const refill = (elapsedMs / 1000) * rateLimit.refillPerSec
+    if (refill > 0) {
+      bucket.tokens = Math.min(rateLimit.capacity, bucket.tokens + refill)
+      bucket.lastMs = ms
+    }
+    if (bucket.tokens < 1) {
+      // compute seconds until at least 1 token
+      const needed = 1 - bucket.tokens
+      const secs = Math.ceil(needed / rateLimit.refillPerSec)
+      return { status: 429, headers: { 'retry-after': String(Math.max(1, secs)) }, body: { error: 'Rate limit exceeded' } }
+    }
+    bucket.tokens -= 1
+
     const url = new URL(req.url, 'http://localhost')
     const match = router.match(req.method, url.pathname)
     if (!match) return { status: 404, body: { error: 'Not found' } }
     try {
-      return await match.handler({ params: match.params, query: url.searchParams, body: req.body ?? {} })
+      const out = await match.handler({ params: match.params, query: url.searchParams, body: req.body ?? {}, headers })
+      // ETag only for GET /books and GET /books/:id
+      if (req.method === 'GET' && (url.pathname === '/books' || url.pathname.startsWith('/books/'))) {
+        const body = out.body === undefined ? '' : JSON.stringify(out.body)
+        const digest = crypto.createHash('sha1').update(body).digest('hex')
+        const etag = `"${digest}"`
+        const ifNone = (headers['if-none-match'] ?? '')
+        if (ifNone === etag) return { status: 304, headers: { ETag: etag } }
+        out.headers = { ...(out.headers ?? {}), ETag: etag }
+      }
+      return out
     } catch (err) {
       return { status: 500, body: { error: err.message } }
     }
diff --git a/test/server.etag_ratelimit.test.js b/test/server.etag_ratelimit.test.js
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..56e5cee
--- /dev/null
+++ b/test/server.etag_ratelimit.test.js
@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+import { test } from 'node:test'
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { createApp } from '../src/server.js'
+import { Inventory } from '../src/inventory.js'
+
+test('ETag on GET /books and 304 when If-None-Match matches', async () => {
+  const handle = createApp(Inventory.fromFile())
+  const res1 = await handle({ method: 'GET', url: '/books', headers: {} })
+  assert.equal(res1.status, 200)
+  assert.ok(res1.headers && typeof res1.headers.ETag === 'string')
+  const etag = res1.headers.ETag
+
+  const res2 = await handle({ method: 'GET', url: '/books', headers: { 'if-none-match': etag } })
+  assert.equal(res2.status, 304)
+  assert.deepEqual(res2.body, undefined)
+})
+
+test('ETag on GET /books/:id and 304 when If-None-Match matches', async () => {
+  const handle = createApp(Inventory.fromFile())
+  const res1 = await handle({ method: 'GET', url: '/books/b2', headers: {} })
+  assert.equal(res1.status, 200)
+  assert.ok(res1.headers && typeof res1.headers.ETag === 'string')
+  const etag = res1.headers.ETag
+
+  const res2 = await handle({ method: 'GET', url: '/books/b2', headers: { 'if-none-match': etag } })
+  assert.equal(res2.status, 304)
+  assert.deepEqual(res2.body, undefined)
+})
+
+test('Per-client rate limiting with token bucket and Retry-After', async () => {
+  // small bucket for test and controllable clock
+  let t = 0
+  const now = () => t
+  const handle = createApp(Inventory.fromFile(), { rateLimit: { capacity: 2, refillPerSec: 1 }, now })
+  const clientHeaders = { 'x-client-id': 'test-client' }
+
+  // consume 2 tokens
+  const r1 = await handle({ method: 'GET', url: '/books', headers: clientHeaders })
+  assert.equal(r1.status, 200)
+  const r2 = await handle({ method: 'GET', url: '/books', headers: clientHeaders })
+  assert.equal(r2.status, 200)
+
+  // now empty
+  const r3 = await handle({ method: 'GET', url: '/books', headers: clientHeaders })
+  assert.equal(r3.status, 429)
+  assert.ok(r3.headers && r3.headers['retry-after'])
+  const ra = Number(r3.headers['retry-after'])
+  assert.ok(ra >= 1)
+
+  // advance time by 1s -> one token
+  t += 1000
+  const r4 = await handle({ method: 'GET', url: '/books', headers: clientHeaders })
+  assert.equal(r4.status, 200)
+})
verify: npm test --silent: exit before=1 after=1; no new test failures
